page.overview:
Who is Jim Drucker?

Jim Drucker was a businessman from Verizon investing in Jurassic World.

Claire Dearing took him on a tour of the Hammond Creation Lab along with Hal Osterly and Erica Brand. When being shown the Indominus rex at the prompting of Osterly, Drucker asked how they'd gotten two different kinds of dinosaurs to procreate, prompting Henry Wu to walk over and explain that Indominus rex wasn't bred, she was designed. He is not seen for the rest of the movie and his whereabouts are unknown other than the fact that he is alive.
